2609.01575.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
2609.01575.paper_summary: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
2609.01575.paper_summary_zh: 從數以億計的文件中提取結構化字段在受監管行業中仍然成本高昂：定制的OCR級聯僅覆蓋工作流程的一小部分，隱私規則禁止外部模型的使用，而現有的開源VLM在達到質量門檻後，提供服務的成本高於人工標註。我們展示了一個基於混合專家VLM（總計35B，活躍3B）的文檔理解系統，該系統在內部生產數據與由難度感知管道精心策劃的開放域文檔混合上進行微調，以實現佈局多樣性、事實可提取性和跨模型一致性。該模型在單個H100上進行訓練，並通過提示服務異質工作流程，領先所有可部署（非推理）基準，規模大約高出一個數量級。質量調整成本分析，基於生產遙測校準的確認和修正成本顯示，與人工基準相比，它將預期成本降低了超過80%，與最佳競爭開源模型相比降低了超過50%，而更大的基準仍然在經濟上不可行。
